reviewer: Codex independent architecture and editorial review

criteria.finding: Fresh content hashing under Node 26.5.0 exactly reproduced both supplied fingerprints. The working-tree candidate remained unchanged during this read-only review.

The accepted architecture keeps governed Markdown as the human record, records.ts as the canonical claim/source registry, generated reports as derived artifacts, and the portfolio as a selective projection. The atlas explicitly avoids becoming a second graph or registry.

Suite v4 declares and implements the requested editorial gates. All 25 bounded queries and all new atlas, outcomes, maintenance, determinism, artifact-currentness, and fixture-contract tests passed. The evaluator correctly rejects stale checked-in judgments rather than granting candidate-binding credit.

The three new synthesis pages answer distinct reader questions and are linked from Start Here, the wanted-page index, and relevant capability paths. The overlapping places/passages concept resolves to one existing record through an alias rather than a duplicate page. Actual unfamiliar-reader navigation validation remains a manual gate.

The atlas explains useful meanings for typed relations while repeatedly withholding causality, attendance, authorship, endorsement, impact, consent, and private social-graph inference. It treats the generated graph as an index rather than an argument.

The operational map consistently separates difficult condition, Jamie's supported responsibility, usable deliverable, wider collective or institutional result, and evidentiary boundary. Government action, delivered proposals, fundraising totals, and legislation are not converted into Jamie's sole impact.

Maintenance remains six distinct, source-bounded modes: physical sequencing, digital continuity, recurring participation, information stewardship, governed memory, and responsible transition. The page preserves collaborators, periods, labor allocation, rights, and unknowns instead of inventing one continuous heroic role.

The alias Places, passages, and publics resolves uniquely to index.people-places-and-community-testimony. The record is reachable within two steps, distinguishes invitation, presence, testimony, response, and outcome, and excludes private identities and inferred relationships.

The four reviewed synthesis records reference 28 unique canonical claims. Every referenced claim has evidence relationships and explicit boundaries, every referenced source states what it does not establish, and 27 claims have explicit anti-claims. The sole exception is the inherently limiting archived-unofficial-status claim, which still carries an explicit boundary.

The synthesis records have no allowed public surfaces, introduce no public Wiki route, and do not change portfolio application files or canonical claims. Generated graph artifacts match the authored records, while protected media and careful claims remain unprojected or guarded.

Generated health and suite v4 explicitly retain human navigation, collaborator consent, rights clearance, editorial approval, and production observation as manual authority gates. No automated result is interpreted as satisfying them.
